description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeWorkShiftAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods such as getOne() to retrieve work shift timings, as well as validation and unsupported operations like delete, update, which are expected to throw exceptions.
external_methods: Organization of internal methods in mock builders and test cases, such as getMockBuilder::onlyMethods, expects, getApiEndpointMockBuilder, createKernelWithMockServices, getRequest, validate

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShiftAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for studying the behavior of EmployeeWorkShiftAPI endpoints, especially the getOne method and validation rules.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of work shift start and end times for an employee, mocking related services.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the API validation rule for fetching a single resource.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the delete operation on EmployeeWorkShiftAPI throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks validation rules for delete operation, expected to throw NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures the update operation throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for update, expected to throw NotImplementedException.
